$comment: Everyday events (domain/events/spec.md §5.22, EVT-115 to EVT-128; feedback 152). Small choices about the realm's own people and stores, drawn from what the game already holds: its officials, lords, ruler and heir, and food stores, plague reaching a province of the player's (EVT-130: not drawn; plague fires it), and the death of one of the player's officials, lords, generals or admirals (EVT-122, EVT-123, EVT-132: not drawn; the death of people fires it). Each realm draws one every `months_between` months (a range), never while the player has an event waiting. `weight` is how often an event is drawn among the ones that can happen; `needs` names what it is about. Options list their effects in the engine's small vocabulary (gold, loyalty, official, lands, heir, heir_risk, food_back, new_lord, quarantine, care, command, home); `ai` weights the AI's pick; `needs` on an option hides it when the realm lacks what it asks (`lord2`: a second lord; `leaderless`: the dead commander's men or ships still without a leader). `{words}` in braces are filled with the names of who and where. Every number is a placeholder for balance.

official_dies.title: Death of {dead}
official_dies.text: {dead}, your {type} at {province}, has died after {years} years in the post. The seat stands empty, and his clerks wait to hear who will take it.

lord_dies.title: Death of {dead}
lord_dies.text: {dead} of the house of {house} has died. His heir {son} has taken his lands ({lands}) and asks you to confirm him in them.

options.name: Ask a fee for his lands
Take his lands for the crown

general_dies.title: Death of {dead}
general_dies.text: {dead}, your general, has died at {province}. Without him his men take no orders and make for crown land, to stand there as a garrison. His second in command, {second}, asks to lead them in his place.

admiral_dies.title: Death of {dead}
admiral_dies.text: {dead}, your admiral, has died at {province}. Without him his ships take no orders and make for the nearest port of yours. His flag captain, {second}, asks to keep the fleet at sea under his own flag.

lord_slighted.title: {lord} feels slighted
lord_slighted.text: {lord} of the house of {house} was seated below a lesser man at your table, and talks against you in his hall.

options.name: Give him an office at court

lord_praises.title: {lord} speaks well of you
lord_praises.text: {lord} of the house of {house} has been heard praising your rule in his hall. A word from you now could win him over.

lords_quarrel.title: {lord} and {lord2} quarrel
lords_quarrel.text: {lord} and {lord2} both claim a mill and its meadows on the edge of their lands, and each asks you to judge for him.

options.name: Fine them both and keep the mill

lord_hurt.title: {lord} is hurt
lord_hurt.text: {lord} of the house of {house} fell from his horse while hunting and lies in his hall with a broken leg.

child_born.title: A child is born
child_born.text: A {child} is born to {ruler}, and named {childName}. The bells ring in every town of the realm.

heir_ill.title: {heir} falls ill
heir_ill.text: Your heir {heir}, aged {heirAge}, is burning with fever. The court physicians shake their heads.

grain_rots.title: Grain rots at {province}
grain_rots.text: Damp has got into the granaries at {province}. The keepers have thrown out {loss} months of grain.

granary_fire.title: Fire in the granary at {province}
granary_fire.text: A fire in the night has burned half of {province}'s granary: {loss} months of grain are lost.

plague_reaches.title: Plague at {province}
plague_reaches.text: Men are falling sick at {province}: fever, black swellings, death in three days. The townsfolk die first. What will you do?

options.name: Send physicians and burn the sick houses

rats.title: Rats in the stores at {province}
rats.text: Rats have overrun the stores at {province} and spoiled {loss} months of grain.
